 "description": "Focuses on the production and processes related to the design and development of pharmaceuticals, especially biopharmaceuticals. Emphasizes signaling problems (continual improvement plans), transparency, validation, and team cooperation/dynamics. Topics may include data management, product quality, and quality instruments.
